es: Si lo hubiera sabido, te lo habría dicho.
natural: If I'd known, I would have told you.
calco: If I would have known, I would have told you.
explicacion: "Si hubiera sabido" se traduce con **had + participio** (*If I'd known*). *Would* nunca va en la parte del if.
"Debí" (y no lo hice) es **should have**. *Must have tested* significa "seguro que lo probé".

calco: I wish I would have studied more.
explicacion: Después de **I wish**, para el pasado va **had + participio**. *I wish I would have* se oye, pero se considera incorrecto.

natural: I didn't do it on purpose.
calco: I didn't do it by purpose.
explicacion: "A propósito" es **on purpose**. *By* va en lo contrario: *by mistake*, *by accident*.
